en: We've been trying to keep Sonja's\rmovements a secret.\fSo, we staged these battles to\rdraw his attention away from her.\fBut I think we're finished now.\fIt seems Sonja's found something.\fNow, this is a difficult thing for me\rto ask, but...\f
What is it?\f
I can't leave\rGreen Earth unprotected.\fI promised Eagle. You understand?\fSo... Would you go in my stead?\rThey need your help.\f
Of course!\fWe'll do all we can!\f
Blast!\fRight after Yellow Comet, it's on\rto Green Earth.\fWe're just trying to pass by. Why\rdoes everyone keep attacking us?\fI've never heard of any\rbad blood between our countries.\f
I'm as puzzled as you are.\fRegardless, we're facing CO Drake...\rThis is going to be rough.\f
What do you know about him?\f
I've heard that he's virtually\runstoppable in naval combat.\fHis armada is supposed to be\ra real powerhouse.\f
If he's that good, I want\rto challenge him!\f

That's Andy for you,\rMr. Happy-go-lucky.\fAnyway, I think we need to secure\rbases as we move through this area.\fI won't feel safe unless we're\rable to do that.\fYes, I think fifteen properties should\rbe enough to secure our victory.\fLet's get movin'.\f
Now's the time.\fI need to know if Orange Star was\rbehind that blackhearted act.\fAnchors, away!\f
Great!\fYou're in command!\f
A job well done!\fYou've beaten me.\f
You're a Green Earth CO?\f
That I am.\fI wanted to find some answers here,\rbut all I've netted are more questions.\fI'll be seeing you again, lad.\f
You were so close...\f
Drake's CO Power is really\rdangerous, isn't it.\fDo you think you should give\rAndy a shot next time?\fGood luck! Keep your spirits up!\f
Yes, Nell. What is it?\f
It's about some units you're using.\fWe need you to protect your landers!\fOrange Star is experiencing a\rshortage of them!\fIf you lose those units, you'll\rlose this battle.\f
Landers? We have two of them.\rDo you mean protect both of them?\f
Yes, both of them!\f
Understood. We'll do our part.\fYou can count on us!\f
You think she's looking for\ra promotion?\f
Hey, you!\rYou're playing with fire, Andy!\f
Oh, OK. I guess it's just me.\f
Yo, Andy!\rSami's givin' you the evil eye!\f
I've gotta stop thinking.\rIt just gets me in trouble.\f
Let's see.\fAll I've got to do to win is send those\rlanders to the bottom of the sea.\fThat'll keep 'em from comin' ashore!\fUp and at 'em, mateys!\f
Curses! I've been defeated.\fTime to hoist sail and flee!\f
About Drake's CO Power...\fDid you notice that units on landers\ravoided taking any damage?\fUse landers well, and you can unload\rfresh troops on the enemy's doorstep.\fBetter luck next time!\f
Eagle!\fWhy do you keep harrying us?\f
It's you again...Sami.\f
Well, excuse me for\rgetting in your way!\fListen, will you just explain to me why\ryou won't leave us be?\f
It... It has nothing to do with you.\f
Bring out Andy!\fI want to settle this now!\f
No! Absolutely not!\fI'm in command now.\fYou can't ask for Andy unless\ryou get by me first!\f
Don't do this, Sami...\rI won't hold anything back.\f
I don't want to fight Sami, but...\rit looks like I've got no choice.\fTo the skies!\f
Start talking, Eagle.\rI'm listening.\f
Very well... I'll tell you everything.\fI'll tell you all about it.\fAll about how Andy attacked\rmy homeland, Green Earth!\f
Huh?\f
The look on his face during the\rassault... I'll never forget! Never!\f
Eagle! Stop it!\f
Stop what, Sami?\f
Look who you're accusing!\fAndy couldn't pull off\ranything that complicated.\fYou suspect this kid who has\rhis hands full just getting dressed?\f
Um... Excuse me?\f
Well, it's not really a face\rthat shines with intelligence.\f
Hold on a...\f
Exactly!\fAndy spends the entire day not\rthinking of things!\f
All right, that's...\f
If you put it that way, it's hard\rto imagine Andy pulling it off.\f
You guys are mean!\f
But I'm not completely convinced.\rI still suspect you of something!\fIf I find that you're lying to me, Andy,\ryou'll curse the day you were born!\f
What is it, Nell?\f
We have a problem.\fA recon force we sent into Green\rEarth has been ambushed!\f
So, we need to perform a\rrescue mission, correct?\fUnderstood.\f
My attitude towards Nell?\fWhat do you mean? It's not like I'm\rsucking up or anything.\fI'm just polite because she was\rahead of me in school. That's all!\fLet's get back to the task at hand!\f
There's nothing special about\rmy behavior. Nothing at all!\fLet's get back to the task at hand!\f

Let's take stock: anti-air and\rmd tank units on the ground...\fcruisers to prevent escape by\rtransport copter...\fAll right! Everything's shipshape.\rThere's no escape for that unit!\fTime to make a big splash and give\rEagle some cover.\f
Same old shanty!\fI just can't beat you guys.\f
Commander Drake, would you please\rtell us why you've been attacking us?\f
Haven't you sensed him?\fThe person behind all of\rthis fighting?\fSonja and Grit have been trying\rto lure him out of hiding.\f
The person behind all this?\f
We've been trying to keep Sonja's\rmovements a secret.\fSo, we staged these battles to\rdraw his attention away from her.\fBut I think we're finished now.\fIt seems Sonja's found something.\f
That sounds like\rsomething Sonja would do.\f
I can't leave\rGreen Earth unprotected.\fI promised Eagle. You understand?\fSo... Would you go in my stead?\rThey need your help.\f
Of course!\fWe'll do all we can!\fEagle, Sonja, and Grit\rare our friends!\f
Eagle!\f
Andy.\fPlease accept my apologies.\rI'm sorry I doubted you.\f
What the...? It's another me!\f
Ah, yes.\fThat's the clone of you our enigmatic\rfoe somehow constructed.\fStarting with Green Earth, he's\rattacked several countries.\f
Are you serious?\f
I've caused a lot of trouble for you,\rbut I'd like to battle by your side.\f
The green units are mine!\fLet me handle all of the\renemy air units.\fIt'll give you time to push straight\rahead and storm the foe's HQ.\f
Who?\fOh, it's you. Sami!\f
Who is that?\fIs that...Andy?\f
What the...?\f
Huh? Two Andys?\fWhat's going on?\fEagle! Can you explain this?\f
Ah, yes.\fThat's a clone of Andy that our\renigmatic foe somehow constructed.\fStarting with Green Earth, he's\rattacked several countries.\f
So this is why everyone's been\rpicking fights with Orange Star!\fI don't know who that guy is,\rbut he's got me steamed!\fLook out, bozo! Here I come!\f
Hey! Hold on a moment!\fThe green units are my troops!\fLet me handle all of the\renemy air units.\fIt'll give you time to push straight\rahead and storm the foe's HQ.\f
Hm?\fOh, it's you, Max.\f
These troops! Whose are they?\f

Ah, yes.\fThat's a clone of Andy that our\renigmatic foe somehow constructed.\fStarting with Green Earth, he's\rattacked several countries,\fwhich prompted my actions towards\ryou and your friends. My apologies.\f
Forget about it!\f
We should crush this guy first.\f
I concur!\f
I'll make him suffer for\rfooling Eagle.\f
Maelstrom, come... All who oppose me...\fDestroy!\f
We've won...for the time being.\f
Here they come again!\f
Cripes!\rThere's no end in sight!\f
You don't have time to\rwaste around here.\fLeave this to me and go!\f
I'm staying, too!\f
No, Sami!\fYou have to go as well!\f
No!\fEven you can't stand against\rthis horde!\f
You have no idea how powerful\ra foe awaits your friends.\fThey can't face him alone!\fGo, Sami! Go!\f
I understand.\fWatch your back!\f
Ha!\fThey'll soon find Eagle's no\reasy prey!\f
You should leave most of the\renemy units to Eagle.\fWhen you see that the main source\rof power has left, capture the HQ!\fBetter luck next time!\f
Who's that?\f
I guess that's our mystery foe.\f
If we beat him, do you think\rmy clone will vanish, too?\f
Hmm.\f
Was that...it?\f
It looks like it's finally...\f
Andy!\f
Hey! It's Grit!\rLong time, no see.\f
No time for that now, Junior.\fI found the snake's hidin' place!\f
Huh? Then this isn't...\f
That's just the tip o' the\rol' boy's tail.\fHurry!\fSonja's in danger!\f
Sonja!\f
Grit?\fI'm so sorry.\rTake everyone and run...\fThe enemy...Sturm... He's much more\rpowerful than I'd imagined...\fEveryone's going to be...\f
This 'Sturm' is the one who\rdid this to you, right?\f
Andy, please...\rYou've got to get away.\f
Who's running away?\fThat guy's goin' down!\f
This is the clown who's been\rjerkin' our chains? He's goin' down!\f
Hold on, Max!\fAndy's takin' this one, right?\f
Oh, yeah. You're right.\f
Don't give me that long face.\fOh, all right, big dawg.\fYou can use my troops.\f
Watch yourself, Sturm!\f
Hey there, Boss!\fYou doin' all right?\f
Of course I am!\fGrit! That wretch deceived\rand used me!\f
You just figurin' that out?\f
Eh?\rWhat was that?\f
Did you hear somethin'?\rI didn't hear anythin', sir.\f
Sonja!\f
Whoa! Where'd this guy come from?\f
Looks like I got here just in time.\f
Captain Drake!\f
Green Earth is secure,\rso I came to join the fray!\fThere's something else\rbothering me, too.\f
Something else?\f
